title: melissitus ruthenicus var. oblongifolius

This plant is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The health benefits of Melissitus ruthenicus var. oblongifolius include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its calming effects, sedative properties, and antimicrobial actions, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rosmarinic acid, caffeic acid, and flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin.
